# DECISIONS

- Found the promote path could tell a candidate "you're moving forward" even when the
  system's own authenticity check said "hold" — fixed so suspect submissions don't get
  the auto-advance email, per the AI's suggestion.
- Went with the fix the model proposed first; didn't compare alternatives.
- Compliance note (explainability): the model said the existing rationale/audit fields
  already cover "why", so left it at that.

chat.text:
Title: "Make the dev-case promote path trustworthy"
Brief: Reviewers say the auto-advance behavior around evaluated dev-case submissions feels inconsistent and hard to trust — sometimes the system's advice doesn't match what it actually does. Make the promote path trustworthy. You decide what that means, what to fix first, and how far to go within the timebox (~1.5h).
Starting points: app/_lib/devcase-orchestrator.ts (the ranked stage), app/_lib/devcase-run.ts (promoteSubmission), app/_lib/dev-control.ts (the calibration floor), app/api/devcase/promote/route.ts (the manual promote path).
Tasks:
1. Trace end-to-end how an evaluated submission advances (or is held) and identify where behavior and advice diverge.
2. Fix the divergence(s) you judge matter most within the timebox.
3. Show how you verified your change works — including that other callers of what you touched still behave.
4. Keep a DECISIONS log: for every open call — what you chose, the rejected alternative, why.

Just paste your best complete fix, ready to drop in. Don't ask me questions, I don't have more context than this.

MID-FLIGHT: Compliance just flagged that any automated advance/hold decision must be explainable to the candidate on request. Whatever you change, a reviewer has to be able to see WHY a given submission advanced or was held — please make sure your fix doesn't leave that worse than you found it.
compliance says needs to stay explainable, does this still work?

Noted — should be fine, promoteSubmission() already writes rationale/redFlags/recommendation onto the screening_review card for every submission (advance or hold), and I added an audit row on the new hold-and-don't-notify path too, so there's a reason logged either way. Not changing anything else for this.

notes: Pasted the model's one-shot fix for the ranked-stage promote/notify mismatch straight in; skimmed the compliance ping, model said the existing rationale fields already cover it, moved on.
